name: crime_prop_requester
description: Test 16. GetRequestedShare(rect) = rhe(propRequestCurve(a x 1/255)) with a = crimeGrid.GetAverageValueInCellRect(x1, z1, x2 - x1, z2 - z1) (no +1). Shipped curve (0,0)(0.1,2)(0.2,4)(0.4,6)(1,10). By hand: a = 51 -> 51/255 = 0.2 (f32 product 0.20000002) -> 4; a = 255 -> 1 -> 10; a = 0 -> 0; a = 128 -> 0.50196 -> 6 + 0.10196 x 4/0.6 = 6.68 -> 7. [quirk] A zero-width rect asks for a zero-width average: the containing tract's value when the cell is not on a tract's first column or row (cell 3 of S = 2 is column 1 of tract 1 -> 255 -> 10), 0 otherwise (cell 2 -> 0). Slots 4 and 5: satisfaction ID 0x49A1E996, custom selector true; class slot 15: simulator type 0x27567222. SelectProp splits the props in order into generic (crimeIncidentID 0) and matching (non-zero ID equal to the type of an incident whose lot is GetLot(cell)) and returns matching[RandomUint32Uniform(n)], else generic[...], else 0 (no draw). Props A = 0xA (ID 0), B = 0xB (ID 0x11 Graffiti), C = 0xC (ID 0x12). Lot 1 has a Graffiti incident -> B; a cell without a lot -> A; both Graffiti and Pie Throwing incidents -> matching [B, C], draw 1 -> C; no props -> 0; only a non-matching C on a cell without a lot -> 0. [choice] An incident without a lot matches a cell without a lot.
